8.6.3.1 NetworkStartIndication
[SWS_FrNm_00470] Definition of configurable interface <Nm_NetworkStartIndi-
cation> ⌈
Service Name
<Nm_NetworkStartIndication>
Syntax
void <Nm_NetworkStartIndication> (
NetworkHandleType nmNetworkHandle
)
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different FrNm Clusters. Non reentrant for the same FrNm Cluster
Parameters (in)
nmNetworkHandle
Identification of the NM-Cluster
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
This API service of an upper layer Nm is called by the FlexRay Network Management to
indicate to this upper layer BSW module that a NM-message was successfully received and the
FrNm is in the Bus-Sleep Mode.
Available via
<none>
⌋
